title: SMC IL-17A High Sensitivity Immunoassay Kit
author: Opentrons
materials: SMC IL-17A High Sensitivity Immunoassay Kit
Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Pause for washes/incubations
steps.instruction: Run the SMC IL‑17A High Sensitivity Immunoassay Kit; be prepared to pause the robot for manual wash and incubation steps on other devices.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input all required protocol parameters in the Opentrons interface as prompted.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file from the provided link and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload your labware definition files (.json) if needed.

substeps.instruction: Open the OT App and click More.
Select Custom Labware, then Add Labware.
Choose the appropriate .json labware files and confirm upload.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol script (.py) to the OT App via the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the OT‑2 deck according to the supplied deck map, placing tip racks, plates, and other labware in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate each piece of labware, the tip rack, and the pipette following the on‑screen instructions (refer to support articles for tips).

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the OT App to begin the protocol.
